results.title: Hospitality Award Wage Rates 2026: Employer Compliance Guide
results.description:
# Hospitality Award Wage Rates 2026: Employer Compliance Guide
## What Are the Current Hospitality Award Wage Rates?
### Classification Rates From 1 July 2026
| Level | Base Rate/hr | Casual Rate/hr | Annual (38 hrs) |
|-|-|-|-|
| Level 1 | $26.44 | $33.05 | $52,245 |
| Level 2 | $27.08 | $33.85 | $53,510 |
| Level 3 | $27.97 | $34.96 | $55,269 |
| Level 4 | $29.45 | $36.81 | $58,193 |
| Level 5 | $31.30 | $39.13 | $61,849 |
| Level 6 | $32.13 | $40.16 | $63,489 |

## Hospitality Award Penalty Rates Employers Must Apply
| Day/Time | Permanent | Casual | Level 1 Base |
|-|-|-|-|
| Saturday | 1.25x | 1.5x | $33.05/hr |
| Sunday | 1.5x | 1.75x | $39.66/hr |
| Public Holiday | 2.25x | 2.5x | $59.49/hr |
| Overtime (first 2 hrs) | 1.5x | 1.5x | $39.66/hr |
| Overtime (after 2 hrs) | 2x | 2x | $52.88/hr |

### Junior Pay Rates (Under 21)
| Age | % of Adult Rate | Hourly Rate | Casual Rate |
|-|-|-|-|
| Under 17 | 50% | $13.22 | $16.53 |
| 17 | 60% | $15.86 | $19.83 |
| 18 | 70% | $18.51 | $23.14 |
| 19 | 85% | $22.47 | $28.09 |
| 20+ | 100% | $26.44 | $33.05 |

## Frequently Asked Questions
Casual employees receive $33.05 per hour, which includes the 25% casual loading.

A Level 1 casual working on a Sunday earns at least $39.66 per hour.

For a Level 1 employee, this means a base rate of $26.44 per hour becomes $33.05 per hour for casuals.

Junior employees under 21 are paid a percentage of the adult Level 1 rate: 50% for under-17s, 60% for 17-year-olds, 70% for 18-year-olds, 85% for 19-year-olds, and 100% for employees aged 20 and over.
